name: BACKWARD LUNGE WITH FRONT KICK LEFT
introduce: Stand straight up. Then step back with your left leg and lower your body. When you come up, kick your left leg upward. \n\nGo back to the start position, and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Your front knee should be in line with your toes.
Your front knee shouldn't go past your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
If you feel it's too hard, don't kick your leg too high.
